name: Time Out Market Porto
description: Taste creations from some of Porto's top chefs, all under the historic roof of São Bento station. A curated culinary experience.
longDescription:
Time Out Market Porto is a culinary event presented by Time Out, a global media and entertainment company known for its city guides and food halls. This iteration brings together a selection of dishes from acclaimed chefs and restaurants based in Porto, offering a concentrated overview of the city's gastronomic landscape. The event serves as a temporary showcase for local culinary talent, allowing attendees to sample diverse offerings in one location.

Visitors to Time Out Market Porto can expect a lively atmosphere within the historic setting of São Bento Station. The event runs over two days, providing an opportunity to explore various food stalls and taste different preparations. The focus is on food, with a casual and accessible environment suitable for a broad audience interested in local cuisine. The grand architecture of the station provides a notable backdrop for the market's activities.

Entry to Time Out Market Porto is free. The event is held at São Bento Station, which is centrally located and easily accessible. São Bento metro station is directly underneath, and numerous bus and tram lines stop nearby. The venue is also within walking distance of many central Porto landmarks.
